description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the ConnectionFailure interface, representing details about a connection failure event including cause, description, and timestamp. It provides methods to retrieve failure status, description, and standard object overrides.

classes.name: ImmutableConnectionFailure
classes.description: An immutable, thread-safe implementation of ConnectionFailure that encapsulates details about a connection failure, including cause, description, and timestamp.

methods.name: ImmutableConnectionFailure
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an immutable connection failure with optional origin, cause, and description. Sets the timestamp to current instant.

methods.name: getFailure
methods.description: Returns a Status.Failure object wrapping the cause throwable.

methods.name: getFailureDescription
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string describing the failure, including cause details, description, and timestamp.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on cause, description, and timestamp.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on cause, description, and timestamp.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the object, including cause, description, and timestamp.
